manifest.name: dsh-ark-quota
manifest.description: Show Volcengine Ark Coding Plan / Agent Plan quota in the DSH Web GUI: a side float panel + settings page, persistent credentials on disk, and periodic auto-refresh.

bundle.text:
# dsh-ark-quota bundle layer: mount the Volcengine Ark quota plugin.
- insert:
    - id: ark-quota
      name: dsh-ark-quota

config.name: Volcengine AccessKey ID / Secret Access Key

readme.text: 在 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI 里查看**火山方舟 Coding Plan / Agent Plan** 用量的持久化插件。

- 页面右侧可开关的**悬浮窗**（`shell.overlay`），点击展开三档用量进度条：当前会话 / 近 1 周 / 近 1 月（Agent Plan 为 近 5 小时 / 近 1 周 / 近 1 月）。
- **设置页**「火山方舟用量」：填写火山引擎 AccessKey ID / Secret Access Key、切换浮窗显示、设置自动刷新间隔。
- **定时自动刷新**：host 后台按设定间隔（默认 5 分钟，可选 1/5/15/30）调用 OpenAPI；客户端每 30 秒同步一次。
- **持久化**：AK/SK、浮窗开关、刷新间隔保存在 `~/.dsh/dsh-ark-quota/config.json`，重启后自动加载。HTTP 接口仅允许本机 loopback 访问，SK 永不下发到浏览器。
- 提供模型工具 `ark_coding_plan_usage`。

- `POST https://open.volcengineapi.com/?Action=GetCodingPlanUsage&Version=2024-01-01`（Coding Plan）
- 回退 `Action=GetAFPUsage`（Agent Plan）
- 火山引擎 SigV4 签名，service `ark`，region 默认 `cn-beijing`。

作为 web profile 的本地插件包安装在 `profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-ark-quota/`，
并在 `profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 中：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: ark-quota
      name: dsh-ark-quota
```

重启 DSH Web（`dsh web` / 桌面端）后生效。首次使用在浮窗或设置页填入 AK/SK 一次即可。

> 凭证为火山引擎「访问控制(IAM) → 访问密钥」的 AccessKey，不是模型推理用的 Ark API Key。

A persistent plugin for the **DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI** that shows your
**Volcengine Ark Coding Plan / Agent Plan** quota usage at a glance — a
clickable side **float widget**, a **settings page**, **persistent
credentials**, and **periodic auto-refresh**.

- **Side float widget** (`shell.overlay` slot): a small "⚡ 用量" tab pinned to
  the right edge of the page. Click it to expand a panel with three usage bars:
  *current session / last 1 week / last 1 month* (for Agent Plan the first bar
  is *last 5 hours*). Each bar shows the percentage used and the next reset
  time, color-coded green (< 70%), amber (70–90%) and red (≥ 90%).
- **Settings page** "火山方舟用量": enter your Volcengine AccessKey ID /
  Secret Access Key, toggle the float widget on/off, and choose the
  auto-refresh interval.
- **Periodic auto-refresh**: the host refreshes the quota in the background at
  the configured interval (default **5 minutes**, options 1/5/15/30) by calling
  the Volcengine OpenAPI; the browser client re-syncs the latest state every
  30 seconds. A manual "刷新" (Refresh) button is also available.
- **Persistence**: AK/SK, the float visibility flag and the refresh interval
  are stored in `~/.dsh/dsh-ark-quota/config.json` and reloaded automatically
  on restart. The HTTP endpoints only accept loopback (localhost) connections,
  and the secret key is **never** sent down to the browser.
- **Model tool**: registers `ark_coding_plan_usage`, so the DSH age

| Part | Runs in | What it does |
|------|---------|--------------|
| `lib/index.js` (host) | DSH host process (Node ESM) | Signs requests with Volcengine SigV4, calls the OpenAPI, keeps the quota in memory, persists the config to disk, schedules the auto-refresh timer, serves the `/dsh-ark-quota/*` HTTP API and registers the `ark_coding_plan_usage` tool. |
| `lib/client.js` (browser) | Web GUI (ModuleLoader bundle) | Renders the float widget and the settings page, talks to the host over HTTP `fetch('/dsh-ark-quota/...')`, and polls the state every 30 s. |

- `POST https://open.volcengineapi.com/?Action=GetCodingPlanUsage&Version=2024-01-01` — Coding Plan
- Falls back to `Action=GetAFPUsage` — Agent Plan
- Signed with Volcengine SigV4 (service `ark`, region `cn-beijing` by default, configurable).

> The credential is a Volcengine **AccessKey** created under
> **Console → 访问控制 (IAM) → 访问密钥 (Access Keys)** — **not** the Ark
> model-inference API key.

The plugin is installed as a local package in the **web profile**:

```
profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-ark-quota/
```

It is registered in `profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: ark-quota
      name: dsh-ark-quota
```

Restart DSH Web (`dsh web` or the desktop app) for it to take effect. On first
use, enter your AK/SK once in the float widget or the settings page — it is then
saved and reused on every later start.

All persistent settings live in:

```
~/.dsh/dsh-ark-quota/config.json
```

```json
{
  "ak": "AKLT...",
  "sk": "...",
  "region": "cn-beijing",

Security model:

- The file is stored on your local machine in plaintext (like most CLI tool
  configs). Keep your profile directory private.
- The HTTP API (`/dsh-ark-quota/*`) rejects any connection that is not from
  `127.0.0.1` / `::1`.
- The browser UI only ever receives a **masked** AK (e.g. `AKLT••••xxxx`);
  the SK never leaves the host process.

1. A "⚡ 用量" tab sits on the right edge of the page. If it is missing, enable
   it in the settings page ("显示页面侧边浮窗").
2. Click the tab to expand the panel. If no credentials are configured yet, a
   hint points you to the settings page.
3. Use **刷新** to force a refresh, **×** to collapse, and **隐藏浮窗** to hide
   the widget (this preference is persisted).

Open **Settings → 火山方舟用量**:

- **AccessKey ID / Secret Access Key**: leave a field empty to keep the current
  value; click **保存并查询** (Save & Query) to store and immediately fetch.
- **显示页面侧边浮窗**: checkbox that shows/hides the float widget (persisted).
- **自动刷新间隔**: choose 1 / 5 / 15 / 30 minutes (persisted).

Ask the agent, e.g. *"查一下我的火山方舟 Coding Plan 用量"* — it calls
`ark_coding_plan_usage` and reports the three windows with percentages and next
reset times. With no argument it returns the cached snapshot; pass
`{"refresh": true}` to force a live fetch.

| Symptom | Likely cause / fix |
|---------|--------------------|
| Panel says "尚未配置凭证" | Enter AK/SK in the settings page and save. |
| "查询失败：…AccessKey…" | The AK/SK are wrong, or they are an Ark model API key instead of an IAM Access Key. Double-check under Console → IAM → Access Keys. |
| "HTTP 4xx/403 …" | The account may not have an active Coding Plan / Agent Plan, or the region is wrong (default `cn-beijing`). |
| "暂无可用额度数据" | No matching quota was returned — usually means no active subscription on this account. |
| Float widget missing | The client only renders the overlay slot while the web page is open; refresh the page, or re-check the "显示页面侧边浮窗" toggle. |

The host half uses **Node built-ins only** (`node:crypto`, `node:fs/promises`,
`node:path`, `node:os`) — it has **zero runtime dependencies**, so it does not
need any extra `node_modules`/peer-dependency wiring (unlike plugins that
import harness packages). The browser half receives `react` from the DSH
module loader.
